newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzania shilling ends week down on dollar.
newsitem.headline: Tanzania shilling ends week down on dollar.

text.p: The Tanzanian shilling ended the week lower against the dollar, but marginally stronger on the pound, the Central Bank of Tanzania said on Friday.
The shilling exchanged at a commercial mean rate of 605.8008 to the dollar compared to 603.6030 on Wednesday. Against sterling, the shilling exchanged at 984.7323 from 985.3849 on Wednesday.
Thursday was International Workers' Day, a public holiday in Tanzania.
Dealers said increased demand for the dollar was the main reason behind the slight depreciation of the local currency over the last few days.
On Monday the shilling exchanged at 602.9100 for the dollar and 974.0083 for the pound on Monday.
"The dollar is increasingly getting more scarce these days, due to speculation of expected tax cuts in the forthcoming government budget," an official with the central bank said.
